meta.title: Santiago Rivera — Software, web, automation, AI
meta.description: Santiago Rivera builds web products, automation and AI systems. Founder of Directa.

home.heroIntro: I build the things companies usually have to assemble from three different teams — design, web and back-office automation — under one practice.
home.introBody: Software developer working at the intersection of web products, automation and AI. I run Directa, a services studio for businesses that need both design clarity and engineering depth without the agency overhead.
home.servicesLead: Four lines of work, framed by the problem they solve rather than the tools they use.
home.capabilitiesLead: A working stack — not a wall of logos.
home.contactLead: If you have a project, a system that is not paying for itself, or a question I can answer in twenty minutes — write.

about.title: About
about.lede: Software developer, founder of Directa. I build web products, automation and AI systems for teams that need both design and engineering from the same person.
about.focusBody: Working on production web infrastructure for Spanish-speaking businesses, and on AI features that actually live inside the products their teams use every day.
about.approachBody: Small teams. Short engagements. Decisions written down. Nothing shipped that the client cannot operate afterwards.
about.directaBody: Directa is the studio I run. The work shown here is built through it.
